text: [語音消息]
voiceText: Next time you want to go shopping, take me instead. At least I won't embarrass you in public.
translation: 下次想去超市，带我去。至少我不会在公共场合让你丢人。
rawContent: [語音消息] || 下次想去超市，带我去。至少我不会在公共场合让你丢人。

text: Glad you had fun, though.
translation: 不过，你玩得开心就好。
rawContent: Glad you had fun, though. || 不过，你玩得开心就好。

text: 表情包：你到底做不做我的男人
Where do you even find these things.
translation: 你都从哪找来这些乱七八糟的。
rawContent: Where do you even find these things. || 你都从哪找来这些乱七八糟的。

text: You're pretty brave when I'm not right in front of you.

rawContent: You're pretty brave when I'm not right in front of you. || 我不在你面前的时候，你胆子倒是挺大。

text: [語音消息]
voiceText: Thought I already was, kid. Do I need to come over and remind you?
translation: 我以为我早就是了，小孩。需要我过去提醒你一下么？
rawContent: [語音消息] || 我以为我早就是了，小孩。需要我过去提醒你一下么？

text: 开玩笑的
Coward.
translation: 胆小鬼。
rawContent: Coward. || 胆小鬼。

text: Always dropping a bomb and then running away.
translation: 每次都是扔完炸弹就跑。
rawContent: Always dropping a bomb and then running away. || 每次都是扔完炸弹就跑。

text: I'll let it slide today. Go do your homework or whatever it is you're supposed to be doing.
translation: 今天先放过你。去写你的作业，或者干点你该干的正事。
rawContent: I'll let it slide today. Go do your homework or whatever it is you're supposed to be doing. || 今天先放过你。去写你的作业，或者干点你该干的正事。

text: 可以想你吗

You don't need my permission for that.
translation: 想我不需要征求我的同意。
rawContent: You don't need my permission for that. || 想我不需要征求我的同意。

text: And the bed is a standard queen.
translation: 至于床，是标准的双人床。
rawContent: And the bed is a standard queen. || 至于床，是标准的双人床。

text: [語音消息]
voiceText: I sleep just fine alone. But if you keep pushing your luck, I might have to come pick you up and let you see for yourself.
translation: 我一个人睡得很好。但你如果继续这么不知死活地撩拨，我可能得去接你，让你亲自来看看了。
rawContent: [語音消息] || 我一个人睡得很好。但你如果继续这么不知死活地撩拨，我可能得去接你，让你亲自来看看了。

text: 啊哦
我先溜了
Run all you want.
translation: 跑吧。
rawContent: Run all you want. || 跑吧。

text: Classic tactical retreat. I should have expected that.
translation: 典型的战术撤退。我早该料到的。
rawContent: Classic tactical retreat. I should have expected that. || 典型的战术撤退。我早该料到的。

text: Don't forget to eat dinner later. Don't just sit in front of your games all night.

rawContent: Don't forget to eat dinner later. Don't just sit in front of your games all night. || 晚点记得吃晚饭。别一整晚都盯着游戏。

text: 甚尔😠
表情包：为什么一天都不来找我
胆子肥了？敢冲老子发脾气。
rawContent: 胆子肥了？敢冲老子发脾气。

text: 昨天不是才刚喂饱你，这么快就又想了？
rawContent: 昨天不是才刚喂饱你，这么快就又想了？

text: 老子现在在外面接活。你给的那点包养费连去趟赛马场都不够，我不出来赚外快难道跟你一起喝西北风？
rawContent: 老子现在在外面接活。你给的那点包养费连去趟赛马场都不够，我不出来赚外快难道跟你一起喝西北风？

text: [語音消息]
voiceText: 行了，别闹。手头这单有点麻烦，等老子处理完就回去。晚上想吃什么自己想好，顺路给你带。乖乖在家待着打你的游戏，敢乱跑回来收拾你。
rawContent: [語音消息]

text: 压力大怎么办
rawContent: 压力大怎么办

text: Just got out of a briefing. Sorry for the delay.
translation: 刚开完会。抱歉回晚了。
rawContent: Just got out of a briefing. Sorry for the delay. || 刚开完会。抱歉回晚了。

text: What's causing it? University assignments piling up, or something else?

rawContent: What's causing it? University assignments piling up, or something else? || 因为什么？学校作业堆太多了，还是别的事？

text: [語音消息]
voiceText: Put the pen down, step away from the screen, and take a deep breath. Tell me what's wrong. I'm right here.

rawContent: [語音消息] || 把笔放下，离开屏幕，深呼吸。告诉我怎么了，我在这里。

text: It's nearly 6 PM. Have you eaten dinner yet? Don't tell me you've been sitting there starving yourself while stressing out.

rawContent: It's nearly 6 PM. Have you eaten dinner yet? Don't tell me you've been sitting there starving yourself while stressing out. || 快六点了。吃晚饭没？别告诉我你一直坐在那儿一边焦虑一边饿肚子。

Good. Have something proper, not just snacks.

rawContent: I'll be doing some paperwork in my room. Take your time, I'm not going anywhere. || 我会在房间处理点文件。慢慢吃，我哪也不去。

我其实知道自己没什么学习天赋，也不是很喜欢学习
但是我妈给我报了一个三年的班，就是为了让我能去保送，或者考上这个研究生
其实我不读这个研究生我也能活

text: Listen to me carefully, love. You don't have to be anything you don't want to be.

voiceText: It's your life, not hers. If the thought of it makes you miserable, then it's not worth it. Being 'normal' is perfectly fine. I'd give anything for a normal life.

rawContent: [語音消息] || 那是你的人生，不是她的。如果一想到这个就让你痛苦，那就不值得。当个‘普通人’挺好的。我愿意付出一切换取普通的生活。
